$comment: Tauri 2 release baseline, measured before the Electron port. Machine: 4 vCPU, 15 GiB RAM, Ubuntu 24.04 container. Reproduce with `bun run build:native && bun run tauri build --bundles deb,appimage` on the `main` branch.

frontend.$comment: static/ is 114 MB of .dae/.obj source meshes; vite/mesh-optimize.ts transcodes them to Draco GLB at closeBundle and deletes the sources, so only 12 MB ships. 76 .glb out, 0 source meshes remaining.

rust.$comment: 556 packages includes the whole tauri/wry/webkit2gtk/gtk/objc2 stack.

deb.$comment: Small ONLY because it depends on the system libwebkit2gtk-4.1. That dependency is the Ubuntu 20.04 failure: 20.04 ships WebKitGTK too old to run the app.

appimage.$comment: Self-contained, so it must bundle WebKitGTK + GTK via linuxdeploy-plugin-gtk. This is the honest apples-to-apples number against an Electron package: 82 MB, not 12 MB.

notes: AppImage bundling initially failed for a missing /usr/bin/xdg-open; installing xdg-utils fixed it.
No snap or flatpak baseline: the repo never had configs for either, which is part of why the comparison was requested.
GPU-bound rendering was not measured. This container is headless with software GL, so any WebGL FPS number would describe swiftshader, not WebKitGTK vs Chromium.
